description: This file defines a PHP class 'Rating' in the Opencart Admin Controller namespace, responsible for generating and listing product rating reports. It includes methods for initializing report tasks, calculating ratings, and handling related data operations.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Controller class managing product rating report tasks and calculations within the Opencart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a series of tasks for processing product ratings in pages, dividing total products into chunks and scheduling tasks accordingly.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calculates product ratings for a specified set of products and returns a success message with pagination info.
